description: Ministry of Water Supply - The Land acquisition for the Storage Tank (currently in use) of Lunuwatta water Supply Scheme and Coustruction of Water Storage Tank Pump house and the Official Residence under Kolonna-Balangoda water Supply Projects Stage II
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains two separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific land parcels for water supply infrastructure projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land properties, their locations, boundaries, and the purpose of acquisition (storage tanks, pump houses, etc.), which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While a government minister is named, this is incidental to the land acquisition process rather than being about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
